angle: lines / user topic: defineFauxCopy panics in every build
verify_by: Add tests/solo-finder-blank-tsvar.gno as gnovm/tests/files/blank_tsvar.gno and run `go test ./gnovm/pkg/gnolang -run TestFiles/blank_tsvar.gno`: expect the Error `faux copy slot 0 holds x, not _` at head. Fix shape: skip defineSwitchVar when ss.VarName == blankIdentifier, or reject it in preprocess with Go's message
tldr: defineSwitchVar writes the type switch variable at numFauxCopiedNames(), a slot `_` never gets, so a blank type switch variable now fails preprocess with an internal error where the merge base ran it
details: Reserve returns on `_` (nodes.go:2309), so for `switch _ := i.(type)` the slot at numFauxCopiedNames() belongs to the clause's first own name or does not exist. defineSwitchVar (preprocess.go:1054-1057) passes that index to defineFauxCopy, whose name check now runs in every build: `faux copy slot 0 holds x, not _` with a body declaring x, `index out of range [0] with length 0` with an empty clause. The finder's filetest route does not reach it: ParseFile parses with DeclarationErrors, and the parser's resolver (gnovm/pkg/parser/resolver.go:183) rejects the statement with `no new variables on left side of :=` at head and base alike, so addpkg, node boot, gno run on a file and filetests never preprocess it. The REPL (repl.go:173, ParseStmts with SkipObjectResolution) and expression parsing (ParseExpr, mode 0: gno run -expr, vm qeval at keeper.go:2048) skip that check and do reach it. Go rejects the source, so the loss is an internal panic message in place of Go's diagnostic, through recovered paths only. A third shape, `case int: println(..)` with no declared name, already fails at the base with index out of range at runtime (op_exec.go:960 writes at slot `size`). Normalising `_` to an empty VarName in go2gno.go's TypeSwitchStmt case (tests/judge-1-fix.patch) makes all four REPL shapes run and keeps TestFiles typeswitch*, switch*, if9 and redefine* green.
evidence: go test -v -run TestJudgeBlankTSVar ./gnovm/pkg/repl/ (tests/judge-1-blank-tsvar-repl_test.go). Head a40c1fbf7: blank-body err=":1:31-73: faux copy slot 0 holds x, not _"; blank-empty err="runtime error: index out of range [0] with length 0"; blank-stmt err="runtime error: index out of range [0] with length 0"; named out="named 3 42". Base a6fa06145: blank-body out="blank-body 3"; blank-empty out="blank-empty ok"; blank-stmt the same index out of range; named the same. Filetest route (tests/solo-finder-blank-tsvar.gno, tests/judge-1-blank-tsvar-empty.gno): head and base both `unexpected panic: ...:9:9: no new variables on left side of :=` from the parser. With tests/judge-1-fix.patch: all four REPL shapes run; go test -run 'TestFiles/(typeswitch.*|switch.*|if9|redefine.*)\.gno$' ok.
